displayName: Foundry model deployments should only use approved models
description: Ensures that model deployments in Microsoft Foundry only use models explicitly approved by the organization, based on configured model identifiers or publishers.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
List of Publishers whose Models are allowed to be deployed.
List of AssetIds of Models that are allowed to be deployed. This can include partial assetIds to allow all Models under a given scope.
